domain: Epidemiology & Public Health (infectious disease transmission modeling)
setting: fictional: the Republic of Orvanthe, its Dunmarrow Province and districts, the Dunmarrow Provincial Health Directorate, its laboratories, Larrowmede Medical Relief, Tamberlow virus disease and every person named are invented; no real place, agency, organisation, pathogen or outbreak is described

distractor_reasons.kettlebank_phl_results_w36-w42.csv: the Kettlebank public health laboratory's results for the same weeks; the turnaround check is the Tamberlow field laboratory's alone and no case count or interval is read from laboratory rows
distractor_reasons.lmr_treatment_centre_admissions_2026-10-: admissions to the organisation's two treatment centres; the planning figure is every case in the seven districts by onset, and the centres' share is applied by the desk afterwards
distractor_reasons.safe_burials_log_2026-10-18.csv: the safe burial teams' log; deaths and burials enter neither the interval, the reproduction number nor the asks

sources.constructed: every file is synthetic, generated for this task by its generator (task179/generator) from a simulated outbreak; the setting, the organisations, the pathogen and the people are fictional
sources.public_specifications: the layouts follow common outbreak line lists, contact-tracing registries, transmission-link exports and laboratory analyser exports in general form; no real system's export, template or report is reproduced
